sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face a crucial away trip to Wolverhampton Casuals on Saturday 29 August, looking to bounce back after their midweek defeat at Foley Meir. The Bach currently sit on 6 points and will need to be at their best against the unbeaten league leaders, who have started the season in impressive form with three consecutive victories.
divisionWide: The division shapes up with several intriguing fixtures this weekend. Wolverhampton Casuals—who remain unbeaten atop the table—host Sandbach in a potential title-race indicator. AFC Bridgnorth, also in fine form with two wins from two, face Shawbury United at home. Eccleshall, Stafford Town, and Brereton Social—all on 6 points—will be pushing hard to keep pace with the leaders. New Mills, despite their 5-0 thrashing at Stafford, host Widnes Town and will be eager for redemption. Foley Meir look to consolidate after their narrow victory over Sandbach. Cheadle Heath Nomads and several other sides remain winless and will be desperate to claim their first points of the campaign.
